scope: Every assembly named by compiler-provenance.json plus checked-in tests/gfx950/portable-*/*.s at generation time. Inline Rust assembly is represented by named tests, not counted in this source corpus.
interpretation: Parsing is not execution support. Stage IDs are independent code/evidence references, not a single supported boolean.
Observed profiles record exact mnemonic suffixes, operand classes/tuple sizes/source abs-neg and modifier values, with source hashes and locations. They do not assert all encodable forms work.
Positive/negative controls are actual named tests of the reviewed semantic family; they do not provide per-instruction-PC runtime coverage. Unsupported rows have no positive-control claim.
Mathematical execution uses the repository exact-real model and disclosed assumptions; hardware receipts use finite numeric tolerances. These claims are distinct.
Unknown opcodes/modifiers, typed reinterpretations, unmodeled control/hazards or aborted traces cannot yield a positive native certificate.

F.meaning: Typed family, arity, register/tuple roles and recognized modifier syntax; not an exhaustive assembler.

FV.meaning: F plus the explicitly enumerated27 binary/FMA VOP source/literal profiles, including type-specific F16/F64 constants; e32/e64 choice is validated only for that pinned set.

FM.meaning: F plus MFMA A/B register classes, tuple widths, C/D file agreement and encoded format widths.

L.meaning: Retain native instruction/PC; resolve local branch labels, reject unresolved symbols and malformed relocation sequences even in unreachable code.

LR.meaning: Only contiguous compiler-proven getpc/rel32lo+4/rel32hi+12 for bounded defined objects; preserve 3 PCs and reject middle-entry branches.

I.meaning: Instruction event includes EXEC lanes, register reads/writes and scalar selector roles; retained on partial abort graphs.

IM.meaning: I plus MemoryIssue/effects with actual space, transfer bytes, held sources, counter and scope; permutation uses LGKM without fabricated LDS accesses.

IX.meaning: I plus MatrixIssue form/operand/accumulator/destination slices; full wave64, source snapshots.

IW.meaning: I plus Wait thresholds (endpgm drains all 3 counters).

IB.meaning: I plus barrier arrival/release generations and active masks; terminated waves leave later generations.

ID.meaning: I plus native s_nop immediate + 1 independent instruction states.

C.meaning: Independent native trace completeness and register readiness/software hazards. Abort withholds positive verification and outputs.

CM.meaning: C plus counter prefixes, whole-transfer bounds, object identity, source lifetime, memory conflicts and required workgroup scope/publication.

CB.meaning: C plus matching live-wave barrier generations/completion; barrier alone does not publish pending LDS work.

CX.meaning: C plus form-specific MFMA result/source/accumulator timing; exact SrcC forwarding only for supported same-form relationships.

S.meaning: Concrete scalar 32/64 bit arithmetic/flags, masks and moves. Symbolic masks remain opaque; undefined SCC/VCC/control/address use aborts. Special shared-base source is an opaque aperture only.
S.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

R.meaning: Opaque compiler rel32 object addresses; exact triad only, SCC becomes undefined after linker-dependent adds. Arbitrary PC values/GOT/externs are unsupported.
R.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

K.meaning: Fixed-width native integer/bit/address ALU, typed symbolic 32 bit ring operations, bit operations and shifts. Symbolic data never becomes concrete address/control bits; general symbolic 64 bit/division remain outside the profile.
K.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

F32.meaning: Exact real-number f32 arithmetic/transcendentals with decoded finite native constants, disclosed exp/log base conversion, scoped VOP3 clamp. No IEEE rounding/NaN equivalence claim; undefined concrete domains and unsupported modifiers abort.
F32.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

F64.meaning: Ordered matching word-pair f64 tags and real arithmetic/conversions; actual inline/high-word literal encoding. Mixed words and reinterpretations fail; no floating rounding claim.
F64.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

H.meaning: Typed F16 low/high components, native selected SDWA source fields, signed-I8/I16 conversion and partial destination preservation. Unknown padding is not zero-filled; arbitrary symbolic bit reinterpretation fails.
H.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

P.meaning: Packed/mixed f32/f16 operations snapshot both sources and honor scoped op_sel/op_sel_hi; mixed half writes preserve the untouched half. Unsupported selector/output-modifier envelopes abort.
P.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

E4.meaning: Finite OCP E4M3 byte decoding, explicit BYTE_0..3 selection; paired cvt default bytes0/1 only. Symbolic byte-format interpretation is claimed once per input and conflicts with signed-I8/other numeric meanings abort.
E4.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

B.meaning: Concrete native comparisons/carry plus symbolic signed/unsigned 32 bit and f32 comparison masks; cndmask selects mathematical values and canonical unsigned words. Symbolic EXEC/branch/carry/address/storage interpretations abort.
B.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

A.meaning: Disjoint AGPR/VGPR allocation; native accumulator read/write/move preserves words. Unified physical aliases are rejected rather than represented as independent storage.
A.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

M.meaning: Typed global/kernarg/LDS byte storage, exact wide/dual components, signed narrow loads, low-bit narrow stores, finite object bounds/alignment; static+dynamic LDS and opaque shared aperture. XNACK replay, atomics, buffers, arbitrary apertures and equal-offset dual DS are outside the envelope.
M.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

Q.meaning: DS cross-lane snapshot permute/bpermute under EXEC; concrete lane indices and LGKM completion. Does not synthesize LDS memory reads/writes or cross-wave publication.
Q.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

X.meaning: Full wave64 dense MFMA; explicit CDNA4 lane/item coordinates and source snapshots. F16/F32/E4M3 symbolic values; finite concrete BF16/E5M2. Format cbsz/blgp 0/1 only; scaled forms require selected E8M0 bytes 127; other layouts/F6/F4/nonunit scales abort.
X.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

J.meaning: Concrete scalar branch decisions over SCC/VCC/EXEC or unconditional local targets; one workgroup, budgets bound loops. Symbolic control is unsupported and budget exhaustion is inconclusive.
J.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

W.meaning: Native counter thresholds retire actual in-order counter prefixes; maximal thresholds do not falsely mean full completion.
W.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

G.meaning: Scalar workgroup barrier arrival/release for surviving waves, including partial/empty EXEC. Does not replace data completion waits.
G.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

T.meaning: Endpgm implicit counter drain and lane termination; NOP encoded 0..15 gives 1..16 states. No fabricated handler/call/return semantics.
T.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.

U.meaning: Recognized syntax only: active execution deliberately returns Unsupported and preserves an incomplete graph. It is never counted as successful semantics.
U.test_scope: Named representative controls exercise this semantic profile; these are not assertions that every corpus PC/operand combination was executed.
